title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - FailsafePowerLimit
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/FailsafePowerLimit. In case the communication between a device and the energy manager is interrupted, fail-safe values apply and the device enters fail-safe state until the communication is re-established. Subclass of PowerLimit per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PowerLimit model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'FailsafePowerLimit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasFailsafeConsumptionMax.description: Property. The relationship between the failsafe power limit and the value indicating its consumption. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasFailsafeProductionMax.description: Property. The relationship between the failsafe power limit and the value indicating its production. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
